subject.title: fix(auth-profiles): import legacy auth-profiles.json into SQLite store on load

question: Should affected tagged upgrades automatically import legacy credential JSON before auth startup, or require an explicit Doctor/Fix recovery action before those secrets enter SQLite?
rationale: Current architecture rules out this PR's steady-state fallback, but source and history do not establish whether importing credential material may happen automatically without the existing doctor confirmation.

options.title: One-time startup migration
options.body: Run the canonical verified migration before auth initialization, with defined backup, conflict, audit, and consent behavior.

options.title: Visible Doctor/Fix recovery
options.body: Detect stranded profiles at startup and present an in-product action that invokes the canonical migration before agents run.

options.title: Keep doctor-only behavior
options.body: Require operators to invoke doctor manually after affected upgrades and accept the resulting recovery friction.

recommendation.title: One-time startup migration
recommendation.body: Run the canonical verified migration before auth initialization, with defined backup, conflict, audit, and consent behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor introduced the SQLite auth-store architecture and doctor-owned legacy migration boundary that the decision would modify.
